physiology_source.paper: Electro-metabolic coupling in multi-chambered vascularized human cardiac organoids
physiology_source.source_data_scope: Source Data for Figs. 3, 5, 6-8 and Extended Data Figs. 1-8

linkage_audit.reason: The public paper/source-data description does not establish a one-to-one mapping from the six GEO RNA sample IDs S7_2-S12_2 to physiology experimental-unit IDs. Inferring pairing from 2D/3D class labels or sample ordering would be invalid.
linkage_audit.required_for_sample_level_validation: explicit one-to-one rna_sample_id -> physiology_unit_id mapping with provenance

policy: No sample-level RNA-to-physiology correlation, regression, or prediction is permitted until explicit experimental-unit linkage is supplied.
